description: Pelican Reef welcomes you for a peaceful and relaxing stay. Located on Corcega Beach, just five minutes from culturally rich downtown Rincon, shopping, restaurants & conveniences. You'll wake to a turquoise view of the Caribbean Sea. Walk out to your private patio overlooking the pool to enjoy your coffee or tea. Take a quiet stroll on the soft sand beach and a dip in the pool, only steps from your door.As the sun sets, you'll be lulled to sleep by the caressing sound of the ocean waves.The spaceComfortable & spacious studio bedroom. Well appointed with Queen size bed and night stands, ample drawer and closet space to accommodate two guests. A comfortable love seat, breakfast table and flat screen tv make this a functional space for rest & relaxation, and lap top work as needed.Your kitchen is outfitted with new appliances, drip coffee maker and utensils to accommodate your wish to cook at home. Dozens of choices for take-out food and dine-in restaurants are located within 1-2 miles of your Pelican Reef beachfront oasis.Your bathroom includes a stand-up shower w/ seat, vanity space and a mirror with good lighting, all freshly remodeled and ready for your stay.Your bedside sliding glass door opens to a spacious poolside patio complete with a love seat, ottomans, and additional seating. This is a great space to enjoy gazing over the pool to the shimmering turquoise waters of the Caribbean Sea. Or, let the tranquil sounds of the ocean lull you to sleep as you swing in the hammock.Just a few steps from your patio, you'll be treated to a soft sandy beach, warm, clear Caribbean Sea water, an outdoor shower to rinse off upon your return, and a beautiful swimming pool to cool off, with chaise lounges to soak in the tropical sun.You're in paradise. Breathe.Guest accessThe entire studio is yours for the length of your stay: bedroom, kitchen, bath, and patio. The pool deck and grounds are shared with other guests, as well as the beach just outside the gate.Book an extra day, you'll want to stay.Other things to noteRincon is famous for World Class surfing with over a dozen well-know easy to access surf breaks within minutes of your Pelican Reef studio. Let us know if you'd like recommendations for surf board rental or surf spot suggestions.There are many beaches suitable for snorkeling, sea shell collecting, and soaking up the island vibes.

description: Step into your peaceful oceanfront retreat in Rincón, where the sound of waves and warm natural light fill the space. Whether you’re here to surf, explore, or simply exhale—this is your tranquil haven.The spaceThis spacious 2-bedroom apartment is designed for comfort and relaxation. • The primary bedroom features a queen-size bed, full closet, bureau with mirror, and a private en-suite bathroom with a walk-in shower. • The guest bedroom includes two twin beds and a matching 6-drawer bureau. • Each bedroom has its own air conditioning unit for personalized comfort. • A second full bathroom is located in the hallway for added convenience.The fully equipped kitchen offers an ice-making refrigerator, water dispenser, 4-burner stove, microwave, coffee & tea makers, and all essential cookware and utensils. title: Private Tropical Apt-Pool/nature/wifi/near Beaches
description: Welcome to La Casa Azul B&B. Our Casona is located on the west coast of Puerto Rico; between the towns of Aguada and Rincón.This is one of the five cozy apartments in our inn. You will enjoy with us our excellent pool area, grove, private museum and our small cocoa crop where we give the Cocoa Tour. Just minutes away you will find the best beaches and tourist attractions in the region.We want you to live like a Boricua!The spaceOur private apartment provides a relaxing, tropical, Caribbean atmosphere.It is located on the first level of the Casona.The apartment is decorated with a minimalist but complete touch. Always thinking that our guests have everything they need for a wonderful and comfortable stay.Our decor is designed to make you feel at home in the Caribbean.The house where the apartment is located was built in the mid-twentieth century. It's one of the oldest wood and cement houses in our community. In the past, sugar cane was grown in its surroundings; but today we have a small cocoa crop and fruit trees.The apartment has 2 full beds, a private bathroom, air conditioning, an equipped kitchen, a dining room, an island-bar, towels, sheets, toiletries, and free WiFi.We also have a smart TV with built-in WiFi.The kitchen is fully equipped with a stove, sink, microwave, coffee maker, refrigerator, kitchenware, plates, cups, cutlery, glasses, and everything you need to prepare your own meals before or after exploring.We have an information table where you will find information and brochures about the best restaurants, beaches, waterfalls, agrotours, museums, parks, and all the places to visit near us.We have a garden, a small forest and an excellent shared pool area. In front of the pool you will see an area with chairs, tables and umbrellas. You will also find the gazebo with grill and the pool shower and bathroom area.There are two additional gazebos with hammocks to enjoy the outdoors while relaxing.We have private parking on the property.Our small private forest is our best place to be in touch with nature. The small forest has more than 300 trees where you can walk the different trails that we made.You'll find signs with information about our biodiversity, you'll see hammocks throughout the forest, a campfire area, and fish ponds. The forest is perfect for bird watching, connecting with nature, and yoga.Our small cocoa crop is located inside the forest. Over 100 cocoa trees that produce the raw material to make our chocolate bars.Stay with us and enjoy paradise!Guest accessWe have high-speed Wi-Fi; perfect for watching Netflix, studying, or working.We provide towels, shower items, toilet paper, and garbage bags. Please don't hesitate to contact us if you need more of these resources during your stay.The room has two comfortable full-size beds, a desk, a luggage rack, a closet, a chest of drawers, a nightstand, and a TV.The kitchen is fully equipped with all the utensils so you can cook your favorite meals. We always have coffee available for our guests in the apartment. In the courtyard, there are three comfortable gazebos, a grill, and a campfire area in our forest. We have all the equipment to make your barbecue except charcoal. You must purchase this yourself. We have a ramp for the disabled in the pool area.The pool has an area with a variety of tables and chairs. It has spaces to put your towel and take a delicious sunbath. It also has its own shower and bathroom area. The pool can be used at any time. In the room, you'll see lists of museums, parks, taxis, forests, agrotours, beaches, restaurants, and all the places to visit near us. We are in a great location between the towns of Aguada, Rincon, and Aguadilla. Therefore, we are the ideal place for surfers and adventurers who love to explore our island.The beaches of all the northwestern municipalities are equidistant from us. So driving between 6 and 15 minutes you will find very beautiful paradisiacal beaches.We also have free private parking.Don't forget to sit, have a coffee, or read a book in the gazebo of our private forest!Other things to noteExperiences at Casa Azul.We have a variety of activities that you can do in coordination with us that will make your stay unique and fun.Cocoa Tour.At our house, we grow cocoa where we produce handmade chocolate.The Cocoa tour lasts one hour. The tour's availability depends on the trees' production season. You must notify us in advance. The schedule is coordinated directly with you during your stay. Cost: $20 per person.Learn about the history, cultivation, and processing of cocoa, and taste our handmade chocolate.Visit our private museum.I am a certified tour guide and historian, and as part of our offer we have a visit to our private museum.The visit lasts 35 minutes and includes a tour of 5 rooms of antiques, art, and carvings that tell the story of the towns of western Puerto Rico.Cost: $5 per person.Tour of Aguada.The tour lasts 2 hours.We explore some of the iconic places of Aguada Town as we stroll through the historic center. Cost: $25 per person.Casa Azul Rules.Each space has a maximum number of guests. Additional guests who are not notified will be charged an additional $25 per person per night.Smoking is not allowed inside the house or in the rooms. We have a for smokers outside. Smoking inside the house will result in a $100 cleaning fee to remove the odor.No pets allowed on the property, except for service animals.If you bring pets, a $35 pet fee will apply.We have a water tank and electric generator in the house for your comfort.The pool can be used at any time. Please do not eat or drink in the pool.Do not run or dive in the pool.In the pool area there is an outdoor shower that can be used to wash off sand if you come from the beach.Check-in will always be at 4:00 PM. If you need to arrive earlier, you must notify us in advance and it will be subject to the availability of your space.Late check-out.Check-out is at 12:00 noon or earlier.Late check-out must be notified in advance and is subject to space availability.An additional $20 fee will be charged for each additional hour after 12:00 noon.The house is exclusively for guests. No outsiders or visitors other than Casa Azul guests or employees are allowed inside Casa Azul premises.Loud noises, screams, and loud music are prohibited at night. This is for the benefit of all guests and the community.If you're going to use our fire pit area or use the grill, remember to turn it off after use and throw the ashes in the nearest trash can. Guests must buy charcoal.Only Casa Azul guests can use the pool area.Our staff is always ready to help.

title: Villa Descalza | The Ultimate Surfers Retreat!

images.caption: Sandy Beach is a 3 minute drive from Villa Descalza

description: Please be sure to click “Show more” to read the full listing description, including important details and house rules, before booking. If you have any questions, feel free to contact us - we’re happy to help and look forward to hosting you!The spaceVilla Descalza is a 2-bedroom 2-bathroom villa. We call it the ultimate surfer's retreat. Its ambiance, decor, and character truly define the Rincon lifestyle. If you are looking to relax, experience breathtaking sunsets, enjoy quiet surroundings and still have all the fun and action Rincón has to offer then this is the place for you! The villa is a short drive away from secluded beaches where you can experience calm waters in the Summer and world-class surfing during the Winter season. One of our guest's favorites is Sandy Beach, just a 2-minute drive!IMPORTANT: This property offers a generator & water tank in case of an interruption in electrical or water service.LIVING AREAOnce you arrive at Villa Descalza you are greeted with a beautiful colorful handmade mosaic tiles plaque with the Villa's name. You will love the way the living area seamlessly integrates with the recently renovated kitchen and beautiful terrace. There is a 4 person dining table, three sitter sofa, TV and AC. The room is furnished with vibrant colors and comfort in mind. The living and dining room opens to the grand terrace via gorgeous stainless steel doors. The modern multi-slide doors open completely; this way the guest can enjoy the expansive and beautiful views. The terrace has a lounge area, dining table, and an outdoor freestanding shower; ideal to remove sand when arriving from the beach or any sandy items into the home. Villa Descalza has a laundry room with a washer & dryer, perfect for an extended stay.SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTSThe master suite has a queen-size bed, 2 personal nightstands, a walking closet, ceiling fans, AC, a full dresser, and an on-suite private bathroom. The second bedroom has a bunk bed with full and twin size beds. Features a small dresser, AC, and sliding door closet. Both bedrooms continue their "surfer" theme vibe with their vibrant colors and wall-hanging surfboard decor. PACK AND PLAY (SUBJECT TO AVAILABILITY): We can leave a complimentary Pack and Play at the property upon request. This should be requested upon booking or no later than 5 days before arrival. Pack and Plays are subject to availability.KITCHENVilla Descalza's kitchen is conveniently located in the living area. Recently renovated with beautiful quartz countertops, colorful creole tiles, and stainless steel appliances. It offers a full refrigerator, toaster, microwave oven, stove, blender, and basically everything you need for an extended stay. It has additional 4 people seating in its counter area. GETTING AROUND & PARKINGVilla Descalza includes two (2) unassigned parking spots. Renting a car is a must when staying in Rincón. Ubers are not readily available in the area. There are many activities within 15 minutes of driving distance and the roads are easy to navigate. LOCATIONThere are many things to do in Rincón, Puerto Rico. This part of the island is best known as "The town of beautiful sunsets." Staying at Rincón you will enjoy a laid-back atmosphere, delicious restaurants, and great surfing beaches. Here are some of our favorite things to do:Explore the large selection of local restaurants. Some of our favorites include The English Rose, La Cambija, Carta Buena, Kaplash, El Tamboo Beside the Point, The Beach House, and La Copa Llena. Check out a new restaurant called La Serina, a great Tiki bar and sushi bar located downtown. Relax at your personal grand terrace or just a short drive away from Sandy Beach. The apartment includes beach chairs, beach towels, and coolers.Enjoy a beautiful sunset dinner at La Copa Llena.Visit the local beaches like Steps, Maria's Beach, Sandy Beach, Domes Beach, and Corcega.Take a picture of the beautiful "El Faro Lighthouse" at Punta Higuero.Watch an afternoon sunset at Sandy Beach or Marías Beach and stop for a drink at the Calypso Bar which is right by the beach. or The Beach House.Take a paddle-board tour with the folks at Rincon Paddle Boards. Guests can rent surfing boars at The Beach House.Other things to noteSTARTER AMENITIESAt West Indies Vacation Rentals, we strive to provide top-notch amenities, ensuring our guests feel at home during their stay. All properties come with freshly laundered bed linens and towels. We provide 2 bath towels per guest and 1 beach towel per guest.We provide a set of disposable essentials to help you get your vacation started comfortably. These include:- 1 set of hotel-size soap and shampoo (per bathroom)- 3 garbage bags- 1 roll of paper towels- 2 rolls of toilet paper (per bathroom)- 1 dish soap- 1 dish sponge- A small amount of laundry detergentPlease note that we do not provide unlimited disposable amenities. It is the guest’s responsibility to review what is included in the property and stock any additional items needed for the duration of the stay.Most properties also include at least 2 beach chairs and an ice cooler. You may reach out to us 5 days before arrival for confirmation. CHECK-IN / CHECK-OUT TIMESCheck-in begins at 4:00 PM, and since this is a self-check-in unit, you can arrive anytime after that.If you’d like to check in earlier, please contact us the day before your arrival, and we’ll confirm availability. When possible, early check-in typically starts around 11:00 AM. Please note that early check-in is subject to availability and depends on our cleaning schedule.If you need a guaranteed early check-in, you will need to book from the night prior to ensure the property is ready upon your arrival.Check-out time is at 11:00 AM. For late check-out requests, please reach out the day before your departure, and we’ll be happy to check availability for you.INSTANT & LAST-MINUTE BOOKING POLICYInstant Booking is available if reserved at least 2 days before check-in.For same-day or next-day reservations, availability depends on our cleaning schedule. You’re welcome to send a booking request, but please note that this does not guarantee the unit is booked—all requests must be reviewed and approved by our team. Requests sent late at night may not be reviewed until the following day, and same-day bookings are usually not accepted after 6:00 PM.We appreciate your understanding!HOUSE RULESNO SMOKING: Smoking is not permitted anywhere on the property. A $500 smoking fee will be charged if this rule is violated.NO PETS: While we are pet lovers, pets are not permitted at the property at any time. A $300 fine will be charged if this rule is violated, and guests may be asked to leave the property.QUIET HOURS: Quiet hours are from 10:00 PM to 8:00 AM. Please be mindful of noise during these hours out of respect for nearby residents/neighbors.UTILITIES (WATER & ELECTRICITY): In the event of an interruption to water or electrical service, the host is not responsible for hotel, alternate lodging, or transportation expenses. If service is interrupted for more than 3 hours, guests may cancel the reservation and request a refund for unused nights only. Nights already used are non-refundable.MAXIMUM OCCUPANCY: The maximum occupancy is 5 adults/children at all times, including visitors. OCCUPANCY ENFORCEMENT: Occupancy limits are strictly enforced. Exceeding the maximum occupancy may result in immediate cancellation of the reservation or removal from the property without refund.TOWELS & LINENS: Towels and linens are provided for normal use only. Please do not use them for cleaning or allow them to be stained with food, grease, or other substances. Charges may apply for damaged or stained items. TOWEL HANGING: Please do not hang towels or any other items to dry in areas visible from outside the unit. A $100 community fine may apply if this rule is violated.SUBLETTING: Subletting or re-renting the property is not permitted.TRAVEL INSURANCE / HURRICANE SEASONWe strongly recommend that all guests purchase travel insurance, not only during the peak months of Hurricane Season (July to October) but also throughout the year to cover unexpected events such as travel delays, pandemics, or other unforeseen issues.Travel insurance is inexpensive and can reimburse travelers for most expenses associated with canceling travel outside of the cancellation window; however, coverage will depend on the policy purchased. Make sure to review and understand the options before purchase.DISCLAIMER: We are not associated with any travel insurance companies.INTERACTION WITH GUESTSWe want your stay at West Indies Vacation Rental to be smooth and enjoyable. You can message us anytime after booking with questions. Starting 5 days before arrival, your designated Property Manager will also be available to answer any additional questions you may have prior to arrival. You’ll get all the essential property information 48 hours before arrival, as well as the Property Manager’s direct contact, so you’ll have support when you need it - before, during, and after your stay.

description: This comfortable vacation home has had rave reviews for its 15 year history. A great property for family reunions, it has two separate, fully equipped villas in an enclosed garden with a 14 X 28 ft. pool. There are lots of places to sit, read, visit, eat and barbecue. The upstairs villa has 3 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms with a large beach view balcony. The villa downstairs, is a 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom separate apartment opening to the lanai and pool area with A/C in the bedroom only.The spaceCorcega beach is one of the best swimming beaches on the Caribbean side of Rincon. The house is in a quiet, family neighborhood only a short drive to the more action packed surfers side of our town with lots of restaurants and shops nearby.About Rincon: Rincon has 3 distinct areas, Puntas, the downtown Plaza and South Rincon, which includes Anasco. Beachside Villas is located south of the plaza near Corcega Beach. Puntas is where the surfing beaches are located and also where the younger crowd tend to congregate. Corcega is more of a family area, as the beach is much more swimmer-friendly. Hopefully this information will help you decide where you want to stay.About Beachside Villas: Beachside Villas is a family-owned guest house that is perfectly suited for large family vacations. It is in a quiet, safe neighborhood, just steps from one of the best swimming beaches in Rincon, Corcega Beach. The private pool has a large sitting area or lanai where the whole family can enjoy being together outdoors. Even more impressive to some of our past guests is the separation and privacy that the 2 levels can offer. Theres always a place to get away for a few moments of rest or time with a good book. The convenience of 2 kitchens & washer and dryer.Please note, holiday bookings are an increase by 20% and require a 5 night stay.Feel free to message us prior to booking to check if your dates fall within a holiday!Guest accessThe entire propertyOther things to noteYou will need to sign a waiver for the pool & kayak, please be careful about sand in the pool.The pool is cleaned twice a week Monday & Thursday or Friday, the pool guy comes in early in the morning and he has keys to the gate, so please wash ur feet before entering the pool, we have an outdoor shower right next to the washer and dryer and storage that holds beach chairs umbrellas and toys for the pool
